summary: Document Konflux pipelines onboarding session for Song Song and Qian (Mar 5, 2026)
problem_description: Training session was delivered to Qian Ding and Song Song Li on Konflux pipelines and NL onboarding. This story documents the session scope, topics covered, and follow-up actions for traceability and sub-task creation.
description:
h3. Session overview
* **Date:** Mar 5, 2026
* **Trainer:** David O'Neill
* **Attendees:** Qian Ding, Song Song Li
* **Context:** SAR-to-NL transition; both have remaining SAR duties (pedigree duty encore support, Tuesday weekly maintenance) but are free for NL onboarding.

h3. Topics covered
* Conflux introduction – Organizational move from Jenkins to Conflux (IBM product, internal consumption, scalability, cloud-native pipelines on Kubernetes).
* Concepts – Namespace/workspace, applications (like K8s deployments), components (pods doing builds, integration tests, releases).
* Hands-on assignment – Fork repo on analytics GitLab, subscribe to Conflux namespace, define application and components; scope adjusted to add a new component to existing application (not new tenant) to avoid Conflux Engineering review.
* Access – Key.io and release image repos; add to Git repo role binding (to be done post-slides).
* GitLab MR process – Validate MR (branch and commit must start with AAP issue key), lint jobs (Black, commit lint, Flake8, SonarCube, YAML lint).
* Commit lint – Format: issue key, action, target, colon, description; Jira-GitLab linkage via plugin (e.g. JS CPD).
* Conflux release repo – tenants/config, stone-prod-02, AAP-AA tenant; customize for K8s templating; build manifests / verify manifests.
* Component onboarding – New component, integration test scenario, image repository definition; release plan admission as needed.
* PR vs MR pipelines – PR pipeline: clone, prefetch, build image, push to Quay; MR pipeline has extra org requirements (ClamAV, Clear Scan, etc.).
* Verify conformer – Upstream release pipeline; conform job copied into integration tests for faster feedback.
* Misc – CODEOWNERS, Argo CD applying config; optional fancy git commit for structured commits.

h3. Follow-up / next steps (from doc)
* David to get key repo access and link in chat; clean up key access notes.
* Create tasks for Song Song and Qian re: Snick, CLA scan, conformer after they complete the new-component exercise.
* Qian to update PR: remove application and release plan definitions, add only the component to existing application.
* Song Song to review meeting recording.
* Proactive task suggested: script/cron to pull conform deprecation warnings and open Jira issues for visibility.
user_story: As a team lead, I want the Konflux onboarding session for Song Song and Qian documented as a Jira story so that we have traceability, can create sub-tasks for follow-up (key access, Snick/CLA/conformer, component exercise), and have a single place to link the session notes and recording.

* Follow-up and next steps from the meeting are listed.
* Supporting documentation link points to the source Google Doc.
